Cyril Peaty, of Lechlade Road, Faringdon, said that he was on his way home from work about 12 o'clock on 24 February when he saw a man's clothing beside the lake. About 15 feet from the side there was a man floating in the water, face downwards. Witness informed the police. LETTER CLUE PC J E Green said that, with the help of Mr Peaty and Inspector Burbidge, he got the body to the bank and found the man dead. A letter was taken from the man's waistcoat pocket, and the Coroner referring to this letter, stated that whilst it had no bearing on the death, it did indicate by its rambling and incoherent composition, that the balance of mind was disturbed.
